title: events/types/selfcheck.diagnosed
description: Payload for event_type 'selfcheck.diagnosed' (native type, feature 009; FR-801): one self-check finding from replaying canonical evidence — a defect class, the event span it affects, and the remediation path. A clean cycle emits finding_count 0 with noop true rather than staying silent.

defect_class.description: Stable defect classifier (e.g. repeated_refusal, verify_failure, params_invalid); null when noop.

span.description: Canonical event sequence range the finding covers; null when noop.

remediation.description: Remediation path (e.g. fix_template_params, retune_threshold); null when noop.

noop.description: True when the cycle found nothing — never invents work.
